name: Band triceps pushdown

phases.name: push
phases.cue: Push the band down until your arms are straight

formTips: Anchor the band high and stand facing it, holding an end in each hand
Pin your elbows by your sides with your hands about chest height
Push down until your arms are straight; only your forearms move
Let your hands rise back slowly without letting the elbows drift forward
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out or drifting forward
Leaning over the hands to push with body weight
Letting the band snap the hands back up
